name: PartnerTap
description:
PartnerTap is a multi-partner GTM solution that helps teams drive more revenue with strategic partners. With automated account mapping, multi-partner co-selling and attribution reporting, PartnerTap is everything marketing, sales and partner teams need to co-market, co-sell, and co-win.

PartnerTap's MCP makes it easier to build and execute co-GTM strategies by surfacing rich context and partner data directly to agents. Working with these agents, authorized users can uncover key insights needed for:

- Partner business planning
- Account targeting
- QBRs
- New pipeline development
- Marketing campaigns
- And more

_published_faq.name: How do I add PartnerTap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PartnerTap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.partnertap.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PartnerTap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PartnerTap provides these MCP tools: describe_report_filters, get_report_filter_values, list_reports, and query_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PartnerTap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PartnerTap in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
PartnerTap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PartnerTap is developed by PartnerTap, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
